node.title: XR nonlocal rank-two trades are quadratic or cubic rational fibers
node.statement: For either nonlocal rank-two profile, dual-GRS_4 scaling identifies the two-dimensional row space with a polynomial pencil of degree at most R-5. Since there are four slopes, the row-coefficient code equals dual RS_2, so a projective change turns the pencil ratio into a rational function phi whose four fibers on the active set are exactly the row zero sets. The R=7 profile is degree two and its three pairs are orbits of one Mobius involution. The R=8 profile has degree two or three; its quadratic branch has four involution pairs, while an explicit F_103 cube-fiber trade proves the cubic branch is genuine. This is a rational-fiber dictionary, not an ownership/counting theorem.
